name: {id}
description:
PUT /auto-install/prepared/{id}

Updates a prepared auto-installer answer configuration.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: ID of prepared configuration for automated installations.

params.name: authorized-tokens
params.description: List of token IDs that are authorized to retrieve this answer.

params.name: cidr
params.description:
IP address and netmask if not using DHCP.

Supports templating via MiniJinja, so this holds either a literal CIDR or a template that
resolves to one; it is parsed and validated at render time.

params.name: country
params.description: Country to use for apt mirrors.

params.name: delete
params.description: List of properties to delete.

params.name: digest
params.description: Prevent changes if current configuration file has different SHA256 digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.

params.name: disk-filter
params.description:
Filter against udev properties to select the disks for the installation,
to allow dynamic selection of disks.

params.name: disk-filter-match
params.description:
Whether the associated filters must all match for a device or if any one
is enough.

params.name: disk-list
params.description: List of raw disk identifiers to use for the root filesystem.

params.name: disk-mode
params.description: Whether to use the fixed disk list or select disks dynamically by udev filters.

params.name: dns
params.description:
DNS server address if not using DHCP.

Supports templating via MiniJinja, so this holds either a literal address or a template that
resolves to one; it is parsed and validated at render time.

params.name: filesystem
params.description: Filesystem-specific options to set on the root disk.

params.name: fqdn
params.description:
FQDN to set for the installed system. Only used if `use_dhcp_fqdn` is true.

Supports templating via MiniJinja.
The [`proxmox_network_types::fqdn::Fqdn`] type cannot be used here
because of that, as curly brackets are not valid in hostnames.

params.name: gateway
params.description:
Gateway if not using DHCP.

Supports templating via MiniJinja, so this holds either a literal address or a template that
resolves to one; it is parsed and validated at render time.

params.name: is-default
params.description:
Whether this is the default answer. There can only ever be one default answer.
`target_filter` below is ignored if this is `true`.

params.name: keyboard
params.description: Keyboard layout of the system.

params.name: mailto
params.description: E-Mail Address.

params.name: netdev-filter
params.description: Filter for network devices, to select a specific management interface.

params.name: netif-name-pinning-enabled
params.description: Whether to enable network interface name pinning.

params.name: post-hook-base-url
params.description: HTTP(s) url with optional port.

params.name: post-hook-cert-fp
params.description: X509 certificate fingerprint (sha256).

params.name: reboot-mode
params.description: Action to take after the installation completed successfully.

params.name: reboot-on-error
params.description:
Whether to reboot the machine if an error occurred during the
installation.

params.name: root-password
params.description: Root Password.

params.name: root-password-hashed
params.description: Pre-hashed password to set for the `root` PAM account.

params.name: root-ssh-keys
params.description: Newline-separated list of public SSH keys to set up for the `root` PAM account.

params.name: subscription-key
params.description: A Proxmox subscription key for the installed product.

params.name: target-filter
params.description:
Map of filters for matching against a property in [`answer::fetch::AnswerFetchData`].
The keys are JSON Pointers as per [RFC6901], the values globs as accepted
by the [glob] crate.

Used to check this configuration against incoming automated installation requests. If this
is unset, it will match any installation not matched "narrower" by other prepared
configurations, thus being the default.

[RFC6901] https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6901
[glob crate] https://docs.rs/glob/

params.name: template-counters
params.description: Key-value pairs of (auto-incrementing) counters.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone to set on the new system.

params.name: use-dhcp-fqdn
params.description: Whether to use the FQDN from the DHCP lease or the user-provided one.

params.name: use-dhcp-network
params.description: Whether to use the network configuration from the DHCP lease or not.

returns.description: Result when creating a new installation configuration.

config.description:
Configuration describing an automated installation.

Certain fields support simple templating via [MiniJinja]. Currently, following fields will
resolve MiniJinja expressions upon instantiation of an answer:

* `fqdn`
* `mailto`
* `cidr`
* `gateway`
* `dns`

[MiniJinja]: https://docs.rs/minijinja/
